scope: Independent read-only review of imported HTML and typed input authority, exact CEF/Chromium source, startup credential policy, temporary profiles and supplied instrumented runtime facts
result: PASS within the reviewed imported-HTML/input data-authority boundary
outerLaunchGuardDecision: The outer sandbox-exec pasteboard Mach guard may be removed for this fixed native OSR/headless renderer while retaining the conditions below. This decision does not establish full native product/runtime acceptance.

checks.evidence: Exact Chrome main parts installs HeadlessClipboard, derived from ClipboardNonBacked, before browser startup. The UI clipboard host uses the current-thread instance. Private text/HTML write, native paste/copy/cut and document.open copy roundtrip passed with a nonnil owned marker replacing all tested OS pasteboard factories; content read/write counters stayed zero.
checks.limit: The test marker is instrumentation and is not the production clipboard provider. Production content authority comes from the exact headless ClipboardNonBacked path.

checks.item: Find pasteboard and native key fallback
checks.evidence: Typed keys use Surface.sendKeyEvent and public CefBrowserHost.SendKeyEvent. OnPreKeyEvent permits the source document to handle the key, then OnKeyEvent consumes host Cmd-E before native platform fallback. Exact CEF contents delegate returns immediately when OnKeyEvent handles it. Context menus are cleared and typed HTTP actions expose no arbitrary edit commands. Exact Blink DOM command table has no CopyToFindPboard/takeFindStringFromSelection/UseSelectionForFind entries; supplied actual DOM calls returned false. Named/find factory/read/write counters stayed zero.
checks.actual: Public native keys produced trusted q keydown/up without insertion after source cancellation, b inserted once, host Cmd-E pre/post counters were 2/2; source cancellation changed counters to 4/3 including keyup. The earlier CDP path failed host-callback verification and remains recorded.

checks.evidence: Six general factories divide into two NSApplication initialization calls and four exact Chromium ClipboardHostImpl.GetPlatformPermissionState accessBehavior queries. accessBehavior is programmatic clipboard privacy policy metadata. The two _cfPasteboard requests have actual pointer ABI and AppKit telemetry/prevalidation startup stacks; the test returned an owned zero pointer. name/changeCount reads were zero, accessBehavior reads were four.
checks.limit: The opaque zero pointer prevents observing later AppKit-internal branches. This is a platform initialization domain limit, not proof that all AppKit system calls or all platform clipboard internals are absent. Imported HTML/input cannot select or access these opaque platform objects. Existing clipboard contents were not provided to the imported HTML in the tested paths.

checks.item: Credential key provider and profile isolation
checks.result: PASS for the named source boundary
checks.evidence: OnBeforeCommandLineProcessing preserves existing disabled features and appends UseKeychainKeyProvider; external Chromium arguments are disabled. Exact Chromium154 creates the mac KeychainKeyProvider only when that feature is enabled. cache_path is empty, session cookies are not persisted, root_cache_path is a fresh mkdtemp instance with a private ownership record. The supplied cold trial checked effective flags, kept the renderer sandbox, exited and removed its profile.
checks.limit: This proves exclusion of the identified OS Crypt key-provider path and use of a private profile. It is not a claim that every macOS framework operation or all user Keychain activity has been measured.

checks.evidence: Cleanup accepts only runtime instance directories with this runtime's executable record, preserves active controller/browser PIDs, unknown material and symlinks, and removes inactive owned records. Normal close sends quit, escalates only the owned child when necessary, reaps identified helper paths and removes the current instance root.
checks.limit: Fresh-profile, forced-exit and full production lifecycle measurements remain a separate runtime acceptance matrix.

checks.item: Imported HTML resource and permission authority
checks.evidence: HTML remains in an opaque sandbox allowing scripts only, under the capability-scoped project preview origin, parent frame-src, controlled bundle resources and Permissions-Policy. The native pipe and generic DevTools calls remain server-internal. Client file actions contain selected bytes and basenames, are validated and staged in the private instance; they contain no client machine path. Native media/general permission handlers cancel or deny, file dialogs cancel, downloads cancel, JS dialogs suppress and beforeunload continues.

checks.item: Color and date showPicker backend OS window authority
checks.evidence: Exact Chromium154 desktop color uses ColorChooserPopupUIController and PagePopup. Date uses the default-stable InputMultipleFieldsUI path to DateTimeChooserImpl.OpenPagePopup. PagePopup is default-stable on desktop; platform-native color is compiled only for Android/iOS. These are renderer popup surfaces, not a macOS NSColorPanel/date-dialog path. The backend is fixed windowless OSR; supplied image code composites PET_POPUP pixels. Client native picker values travel through the typed control-value path.
checks.limit: showPicker is not claimed to be universally disabled. Actual popup pixel placement, select/date/color interaction, source isTrusted compatibility and client value behavior remain for the integrated controls matrix. Fixed settings/default features must be retained.

conditionsForOuterGuardRemoval: Keep exact declared CEF154 distribution, true headless=new, windowless OSR, inner Chromium renderer sandbox and command_line_args_disabled.
Keep fixed UseKeychainKeyProvider exclusion, fresh private instance profiles, empty persistent cache_path and owned lifecycle cleanup.
Keep imported HTML in its opaque project-resource sandbox with the current resource/permission policy; keep protocol execution and arbitrary DevTools/edit commands server-internal.
Keep public SendKeyEvent input, post-render host Find shortcut handling, cleared native context menus, permission/file/download/dialog handlers and the selected-byte file interface.

Describe AppKit initialization/CF-bridge and accessBehavior as platform metadata domains with their actual evidence limits; do not promise zero system calls or treat instrumentation as a production interposer.
Run the separately planned native controls, client PCM and normal/forced lifecycle acceptance before declaring the complete native renderer or full product supported.
concreteRemainingReachableContentRisk: No additional existing-OS-clipboard content, identified credential-provider or macOS picker-dialog path was found in the reviewed fixed imported-HTML/typed-input authority. Broader native platform internals are outside this scoped conclusion.
